title: War Writs
changes: Bounty boards now post War Writs from your clan's leader: rout rival soldiers, hold a standard on the front, or clear the wild beasts from your clan's land.
A writ pays gold, renown and valor for your clan, more when your clan is losing. You can carry one writ next to your bounty.
Up to three writs a day. A writ is withdrawn without pay if its land changes hands or you swear to another clan.
